panels.scene: SAM at a desk far away, glancing at a wall clock, phone in hand, the green kettle on a shelf.
dialogue: Is five still a good time?
panels.caption: The clocks go back soon.

panels.scene: JUNE in her garden in a cardigan with gloves, trowel in hand, late autumn leaves around her, phone held to her ear.
dialogue: Make it four. Light goes early.

panels.scene: SAM at his desk laughing softly, writing the new time on a sticky note.
panels.caption: She picked the new time.
